Arrays of the same size whose elements at the same index belong to one record, e.g. Names[i] and Marks[i].
Using an index below the lower or above the upper bound causes a run-time error.
One identifier for many values; a loop with a variable index processes them all; easy to search and sort.
Store the index with the value: IF A[i] > Max THEN Max ← A[i], Where ← i.
In Rainfall[4] = 25, 4 is the index (position) and 25 is the element (value).
